mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a tight labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 4% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A large monthly drop in industrial production signals a supply shock that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as markets reassess growth prospects.
failure_condition: INDPRO drops > 0.5% MoM but SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts rise above a 1.2 million annualized rate, it signals strong consumer demand that will boost economic growth and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST rises above 1.2m but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises above 5% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real retail sales growth accelerates by more than 1% month-over-month, it signals a surge in consumer spending that will boost corporate revenues and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS MoM growth > 1% but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment growth slows by more than 100,000 jobs month-over-month, it signals a weakening labor market that will negatively impact consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS MoM growth < -100k but SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate rises above 3% and the federal funds rate is below 2%, it signals an inflationary environment that the Fed is behind the curve on, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as markets price in tighter policy.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 3% and FEDFUNDS < 2% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.
